svg.text: A. Four Security Defenses in core/src/agents_md.rs
Defeating untrusted-repo injection, root-marker traversal, and SMB NTLM leaks
1. Untrusted Project Gate (load_project_instructions, L64–66)
if config.active_project.is_untrusted() -> return ONLY ~/.codex/AGENTS.md
Refuses to read repo AGENTS.md before explicit user trust—blocking zero-click
prompt injection when inspecting freshly cloned third-party repositories.
2. Anti-Traversal Config Layer Filter (agents_md_paths, L200–206)
Skips ConfigLayerSource::Project { .. } when merging project_root_markers!
Prevents a malicious repo .codex/config.toml from setting root markers that
trick Codex into walking ABOVE the git root into $HOME or parent secrets.
3. Executor-OS Path & Windows SMB/NTLM Guard (L281–290)
Rejects '.', '..', '/', '\0', plus '\' & ':' when executor cwd is Windows.
Even metadata stat() on \\attacker\share\doc.md leaks ambient Windows NTLM
hashes—checked against remote ExecutorFileSystem OS, not host cfg!(windows)!
4. Sandbox-Scoped Reads + Role="user" Privilege Isolation
Threads FileSystemSandboxContext into stat/read (fails closed if sandboxed);
emits under role="user" with "--- project-doc ---" provenance boundary.
B. Top-Down Cascade & Append-Only CWD Transitions
buffered(256) remote probes + single-winner override + saturating byte budget
Top-Down [project_root ..= cwd] · 1st Match Wins Per Directory
Host Global: ~/.codex/AGENTS.md (user_instructions + thread_instructions)

Followed by boundary marker: "

--- project-doc ---

" (emitted once!)
d₀ = /repo (.git root): AGENTS.override.md > AGENTS.md > fallbacks
AGENTS.override.md shadows /repo/AGENTS.md, but NOT child dirs!
d₁..dₖ = /repo/crates/core (cwd): buffered(256) concurrent stat() probes
Shared project_doc_max_bytes budget; lossy UTF-8 truncation on overflow.
Multi-Environment Turn? Switches to `for \`<env_id>\` with root <cwd>` headers
and omits outer single-directory XML wrapper (LoadedAgentsMd::text, L379–485).
Mid-Session CWD Shift (world_state/agents_md.rs:44–80)
• Same (directory, text) snapshot -> emits 0 tokens (100% KV-cache hit).
• Agent cd's into sub-crate with deeper AGENTS.md -> appends tail message
"These AGENTS.md instructions replace all previously provided..."
• Agent leaves repo / docs removed -> appends tail REMOVAL_NOTICE once.
